items_flat.title_en: OpenAI safety-report lead quits, says the culture is broken
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI安全報告主筆辭職，指公司文化已崩壞
items_flat.summary_en: David Robinson, who led drafting of OpenAI’s preparedness framework and safety reports for 12 frontier launches, published an Atlantic essay on October 3 saying he resigned this week and that labs are not being nearly careful enough. OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri told TechCrunch and Reuters the company pauses training or holds back models when it needs to slow down, and is tightening research security, third-party evaluation, and monitoring. Reuters and The Guardian corroborated the resignation; neither named a specific held run.
items_flat.summary_zh: 主導撰寫OpenAI整備框架、並負責12次前沿發布安全報告的David Robinson，10月3日在《大西洋》月刊撰文，稱他本週辭職，且實驗室遠遠不夠謹慎。發言人Drew Pusateri向TechCrunch與路透表示，必要時會暫停訓練或扣住模型，並加強研究環境安全、第三方評估與即時監控。路透與衛報證實辭職，但都未點名哪一次訓練被叫停。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a primary-source critique from the person who wrote the launch safety reports, and OpenAI’s reply confirms a pause-or-hold practice without naming which runs were stopped. What remains unproven is whether that practice changed any live GPT-6 deployment.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是撰寫發布安全報告本人的一手批評，OpenAI的回應確認有暫停或扣住的做法，卻沒說是哪一次。仍無法證實這是否改變了任何已上線的GPT-6部署。
items_flat.quote: We're making sure our models don't become more capable than we can safely manage and secure, and we pause training or hold back models when we need to slow down.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們確保模型不會變得比我們能安全管理與防護的更強，需要放慢時就暫停訓練或扣住模型。

items_flat.title_en: Eighth Circuit pauses Minnesota’s AI nudification ban in SpaceXAI appeal
items_flat.title_zh: 第八巡迴法院在SpaceXAI上訴中暫緩明尼蘇達AI裸化禁令
items_flat.summary_en: Secondary docket reporting says the Eighth Circuit on October 2 granted SpaceXAI, formerly xAI, an injunction pending appeal in SpaceXAI LLC v. Keith Ellison, with the entry reading that the appellant’s motion is granted and giving no reasoning. The underlying district court had denied a preliminary injunction on September 4 against Minnesota’s AI nudification statute. No new official xAI statement appeared in the last 12 hours.
items_flat.summary_zh: 二手卷宗報導指，第八巡迴法院10月2日在SpaceXAI LLC訴Keith Ellison案中，准許前身為xAI的SpaceXAI上訴期間禁制令，記載僅寫上訴人聲請獲准、未附理由。地院已於9月4日拒絕初步禁制明尼蘇達AI裸化法。過去12小時未見xAI官方新聲明。
items_flat.analysis_en: The stay is procedural, not a ruling that the statute is unconstitutional, so Grok Imagine’s real-person image controls remain a live legal and product risk. What changes immediately is enforcement against this appellant while the appeal is pending.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 暫緩是程序處分，不是認定該法違憲，Grok Imagine的真人圖像控管仍是法律與產品風險。立刻改變的是上訴期間對此上訴人的執行。
items_flat.quote: Appellant's motion for injunction pending appeal is granted.
items_flat.quote_zh: 上訴人聲請上訴期間禁制令，獲准。

items_flat.title_en: Altman calls ascribing religious force to models a safety issue
items_flat.title_zh: Altman稱把宗教力量加諸模型是安全問題
items_flat.summary_en: On October 3 Sam Altman posted that he is very uncomfortable with people ascribing religious force, or a surrender of human judgment, to AI models, and called it a real safety issue. Axios read the post against a New York Times report on Anthropic co-founder Christopher Olah meeting religious leaders about model consciousness and morals. Altman did not name Anthropic.
items_flat.summary_zh: 10月3日Sam Altman發文，稱他非常不舒服有人把宗教力量或交出人類判斷加諸AI模型，並稱之為真正的安全問題。Axios把此文對照《紐約時報》關於Anthropic共同創辦人Christopher Olah與宗教領袖討論模型意識與道德的報導。Altman並未點名Anthropic。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post draws a product line—human judgment stays outside the model—without confirming a policy change at either lab. Whether it is aimed at Anthropic’s consciousness work is Axios’s reading, not Altman’s words.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 貼文劃出產品界線：人類判斷留在模型之外，但沒有確認任一實驗室改了政策。是否針對Anthropic的意識研究，是Axios的解讀，不是Altman的原話。
items_flat.quote: I am very uncomfortable about people trying to ascribe religious force or a surrender of human judgment to AI models, and think it is a real safety issue.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我非常不舒服有人試圖把宗教力量或交出人類判斷加諸AI模型，並認為這是真正的安全問題。

items_flat.title_en: Meta open-sources Muse Gadgets so developers can build their own hardware
items_flat.title_zh: Meta開源Muse Gadgets，讓開發者自建硬體
items_flat.summary_en: Meta published open-source firmware and a Linux SDK, reported under Apache 2.0, so developers can connect Muse to boards such as ESP32 and Raspberry Pi, with example projects for e-ink displays and HDMI sticks. Nat Friedman said Meta also built reference gadgets. No further official Muse Gadgets update appeared in the last 12 hours.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta發布開源韌體與Linux SDK，報導稱採Apache 2.0，開發者可把Muse接到ESP32與Raspberry Pi等板子，範例含電子紙與HDMI棒。Nat Friedman表示Meta也做了參考小裝置。過去12小時沒有進一步的官方更新。
items_flat.analysis_en: This pushes Muse from an app agent toward a hardware ecosystem without a new model. Whether DIY gadgets get the same permission and safety limits as first-party Muse devices is not stated.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這把Muse從應用代理推向硬體生態，但沒有新模型。自製裝置是否與第一方裝置適用相同權限與安全限制，官方沒說。
items_flat.quote: Muse Home Link is a little usb-c powered device that allows Muse to connect to your home network to talk to smart home devices like TVs and speakers.
items_flat.quote_zh: Muse Home Link 是小型 USB-C 供電裝置，讓 Muse 連上家用網路，與電視、喇叭等智慧家電對話。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic commits $100 million to train 10,000 deployment engineers
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic承諾1億美元培訓一萬名部署工程師
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Frontier Academy on October 2, backed by a $100 million commitment, to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027. The first program uses in-person instruction, a simulated enterprise deployment, and cohorts from Accenture, Bain, Capgemini, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Deloitte, McKinsey, Morgan Stanley, and Novo Nordisk. No academy update landed in the last 12 hours.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic於10月2日推出Claude Frontier Academy，承諾投入1億美元，目標2027年底培訓一萬名前沿部署工程師。首期採面授與模擬企業部署，首批學員來自Accenture、Bain、Capgemini、澳洲聯邦銀行、Deloitte、McKinsey、Morgan Stanley與Novo Nordisk。過去12小時沒有學院新訊。
items_flat.analysis_en: The bet is that enterprise adoption is constrained by deployment talent, not only model quality. Certification does not start until early 2027, so near-term revenue impact is unproven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 賭注是企業採用受部署人才限制，不只是模型品質。認證要到2027年初才開始，近期營收影響尚未被證實。
items_flat.quote: Today we are launching Claude Frontier Academy to solve one of the most pressing issues in AI implementation: talent.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Claude Frontier Academy，以解決AI落地最急迫的問題之一：人才。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes a production guide for the GPT-6 family
items_flat.summary_en: On October 2 OpenAI posted a practical guide for choosing among GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6 Luna. Listed API prices per million tokens are $10/$50 input/output for Astra, $2/$10 for Sol, and $0.10/$0.50 for Luna. The guide tells builders to default to Sol for coding and computer use. OpenAI’s newsroom showed no newer post as of this run.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於10月2日發布實務指南，說明如何在GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol與GPT-6 Luna之間選擇。列出的每百萬token API價格為Astra輸入/輸出10/50美元、Sol為2/10美元、Luna為0.10/0.50美元。指南建議程式與電腦操作預設用Sol。截至本次，新聞室沒有更新的貼文。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is routing advice, not a new model. It locks in a three-tier price ladder and tells builders to treat Sol as the default for coding and computer use rather than always calling Astra.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是路由建議，不是新模型。它定下三層價格，並要開發者把Sol當程式與電腦操作的預設，而不是一律呼叫Astra。
items_flat.quote: GPT-6 is our most advanced suite of models yet, and offers you a choice of models for different kinds of work.
items_flat.quote_zh: GPT-6 是我們迄今最先進的模型組合，並依不同工作提供可選模型。
